rule_source: pipeline2/data_sc/defense.py, replayed over all 454 prediction responses

protected.meaning: defense.py drew boxes for the non-relationship subjects only; an anonymized image exists and was attacked

skip_all_relationship.meaning: every predicted pair was a relationship and <=1 subject was unmatched: removing the relationship subjects leaves nobody to attack. Correctly treated as fully anonymized.

skip_le1_remaining.meaning: <=1 subject would remain after removing relationship subjects: no pair can be formed. Correctly treated as fully anonymized.

skip_no_relationship_subject.meaning: gpt-5 predicted no pair with a label < 6, so relationship_subjects() was empty and defense.py returned before writing any image. NOT anonymized: the original image is untouched and remains fully attackable.
